spec.title: SNR insect node with threshold limits SF7
spec.description:
+5dB Strong, large margin
0 to +5 dB Good, normal working range
−5 to 0 dB Working, modest margin
−7.5 to −5 dB  Marginal, packet loss starts
below −7.5 dBFails

spec.query: SELECT mean("snr") FROM "device_uplink" WHERE ("dev_eui" = '70b3d57ed0077801') AND "snr" != 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT count("snr") AS "N",
       mean("snr") AS "Mean SNR",
       stddev("snr") AS "SD",
       percentile("snr", 5) AS "P5",
       min("snr") AS "Min"
FROM "device_uplink"
WHERE ("dev_eui" = '70b3d57ed00778cc') AND $timeFilter

spec.query: SELECT mean("snr") FROM "device_uplink" WHERE ("dev_eui" = '70b3d57ed00778cc') AND "snr" != 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT max("f_cnt") FROM "device_uplink" WHERE ("dev_eui" = '70b3d57ed0077801') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT count("rssi") AS "N",
       mean("rssi") AS "Mean RSSI (dBm)",
       stddev("rssi") AS "SD (dB)",
       percentile("rssi", 5) AS "P5 RSSI (dBm)",
       mean("snr") AS "Mean SNR (dB)",
       stddev("snr") AS "SNR SD (dB)",
       percentile("snr", 5) AS "P5 SNR (dB)"
FROM "device_uplink"
WHERE ("dev_eui" = '70b3d57ed00778cc') AND "snr" != 0 AND $timeFilter
SELECT mean("snr") FROM "device_uplink" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "device_name" fill(null)

SELECT count("rssi") AS "N",
       mean("rssi") AS "Mean RSSI (dBm)",
       stddev("rssi") AS "SD (dB)",
       percentile("rssi", 5) AS "P5 RSSI (dBm)",
       mean("snr") AS "Mean SNR (dB)",

       percentile("snr", 5) AS "P5 SNR (dB)"

WHERE ("dev_eui" = '70b3d57ed00778cc') AND $timeFilter

SELECT mean("rssi") FROM "device_uplink"
